name: team-synth
title: Team Synth Grid
description: A near-black team section with a glowing purple floor, a huge gradient title and three photo cards. Hovering a card lifts it, brings the portrait into colour and lights cyan details.
use: A game studio, esports team or creative brand wants a moody synthwave about page with portrait cards.
avoid: Light or brand-neutral themes: the near-black background and cyan, violet and pink accents are hardcoded.
a11y: The colour and lift only fire on mouse hover, so keyboard users miss them; motion does not check reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black page crossed by a faint square grid at the top and a violet glow rising from the bottom. A wide italic uppercase heading in cyan-to-blue gradient sits over a short grey rule, above three square portraits in dark violet frames with cyan names, tiny pink roles and five thin bars.
behaves: On first view the title and cards rise in one after another. Hovering a card tilts and lifts it, swaps the greyscale photo for full colour, draws cyan corner brackets and fills the five segment bars, then all of it fades back when the pointer leaves.
customise: Names, roles and photos sit in a hardcoded three-item array; the neon palette, grid overlay and hover lift need source edits.
weight: light: Three photos, a CSS grid overlay and hover styles; only the one-time entrance animates.
demo: Title "The Network" and three members: Amélie Laurent, Nikolas Gibbons, Sienna Hewitt.
issues: Each card opens greyscale and dim, so the portraits look drained until hovered.
The tiny pink role text sits low contrast on the dark violet card.
polishWhy: Tight synthwave palette, grid and hover effects; the role line is small and dim.
